description: Seal a call on a public company's next fiscal-year revenue beside Edgarette's own 80% range, before the annual report is filed. Give the company (ticker or CIK) and a low and high in whole US dollars. Returns a receipt: a hash of the company, the year, the range and the moment it was logged, on a public page. The call is graded inside or outside by the revenue in the company's next 10-K, the same filing that grades the house range. Free, no key, no name stored; refused once the annual report is on file. Call with only the company to read the house range and the calls already sealed. A statistical record, not a rating or a recommendation.

high.description: high end of the range, whole US dollars

low.description: low end of the range, whole US dollars
